legend_intro: Is report ke har claim par ek label hai jo batata hai ki ye baat kaise pata chali.
legend_ids: File paths, function names aur code kabhi translate nahi hote. Line numbers analysed commit ke hain; purane references flag kiye jaate hain.
v_verified-source_desc: Bataayi gayi lines ke code se seedha padha gaya (parse kiya, guess nahi).
v_structurally-inferred_desc: Code ke structure se nikala gaya (jaise naam se match hua method). Shayad sahi hai, par proven nahi.
v_test-verified_desc: Aise test par based jo sach mein chala aur recorded run mein pass hua.
v_runtime-observed_desc: Program ke asli, instrumented run mein dekha gaya.
v_partially-verified_desc: Kuch parts confirm hain; baaki abhi check karne hain.
v_not-verified_desc: Bina proof ke kaha gaya; ise hypothesis samjho.
nav_hint: Tip: har path:line link exact source lines kholta hai.
no_description: Manifests mein project ka description nahi mila.
auto_summary: Zyaada tar **{lang}** mein hai (analysed lines ka {share}%). Detect hue frameworks: {fw}. {entries} entry point, {routes} route, {tests} test files.
auto_summary_note: Ye summary manifests aur parsed code se bani hai. Agent ka likha explanation add hone par yahan dikhega.
layer_hint_note: Layer hints folder ke naamon se guess kiye gaye hain (inferred). Graph ke edges asli imports aur calls se aate hain.
env_vars_note: Sirf naam dikhaye jaate hain. Values kabhi read ya store nahi hoti.
calls_resolution: {total} mein se {unresolved} call sites statically resolve nahi ho payi (dynamic calls, callbacks, third-party objects).
excluded_dirs: {n} folders analysis se bahar rakhe gaye
limitations_static: Static analysis dependency injection, reflection, config-driven wiring ya runtime registration nahi dekh sakta. Jo areas explore nahi hue, woh upar list hain.
md_lang_summary: Zyaada tar **{lang}** mein ({share}% analysed lines; {files} files, {lines} lines).
arch_sub: Modules aur files jo asli import aur call edges se jude hain. Details ke liye node par click karo; module ki files kholne ke liye double-click karo.
arch_help: Node ka size code lines dikhata hai. Laal nodes import cycle ka hissa hain.
arch_select: Incoming aur outgoing relationships dekhne ke liye koi node select karo.
flows_sub: Source-backed execution path ko step by step dekho. Har step par exact responsible code dikhta hai.
flow_static_note: Source code se reconstruct kiya gaya (inferred). Ye kisi asli run ki recording nahi hai.
flow_unresolved_note: {n} steps statically resolve nahi ho paaye; asli path alag ho sakta hai.
lane_diagram: Har step kis file mein chalta hai
scenarios_note: Flow mein mile final outcomes aur unse pehle ki nearest conditions (inferred).
no_outcomes: Is flow mein koi final outcome nahi mila.
no_flows: Abhi koi flow nahi hai. Agent se koi feature trace karne ko bolo, ya chalao:
code_sub: Embedded source browse karo. Report ke kisi bhi link se yahan lines highlight hokar khulti hain.
pick_file: Left side se koi file chuno, ya koi path:line link kholo.
not_embedded: Ye source report mein embedded nahi hai (size budget). Apne editor mein kholo:
resolved_edges_only: Sirf statically resolved edges dikhaye gaye hain.
learn_sub: Tumhare liye likhe gaye explanations, har ek exact source lines se juda hua. Apni depth chuno.
translation_missing: Ye explanation abhi selected language mein available nahi hai; English dikha rahe hain.
no_explanations: Abhi koi explanation nahi hai. Agent inhe is command se add karta hai:
contribute_sub: Is code ko safely badalne ke liye sab kuch: ye kahan hai, ise kaun call karta hai, kaunse tests ise cover karte hain, aur kya abhi unknown hai.
no_contexts: Abhi koi contribution context nahi hai. Chalao:
context_note: Statuses batate hain ki engine ne kya dhoondha. Kisi area ko 'reviewed' tabhi maano jab uska evidence padh liya ho.
routes_reaching: Is code tak pahunchne wale routes
ready_1: Main lines cite karke bata sakta/sakti hoon ki code aaj kya karta hai.
ready_2: Maine har direct caller padh liya hai.
ready_3: Mujhe pata hai kaunse tests ise cover karte hain aur maine unhe chalaya hai.
ready_4: Maine branch conditions aur error paths socha hai.
ready_5: Main repository ke existing conventions follow kar raha/rahi hoon.
ready_6: Main explain kar sakta/sakti hoon ki mera change kya karta hai aur kyun.
no_changes: Abhi koi change analysis nahi hai. Code edit karne ke baad chalao:
changes_summary: `{baseline}` se comparison: {added} added, {modified} modified, {deleted} deleted files; {syms} symbols badle; {impacted} symbols impacted.
sim_sub: Behaviour ko certainty ke teen levels par explore karo. Har level labelled hai; inhe kabhi mix nahi kiya jaata.
sim_l1_desc: Code se reconstruct kiye gaye possible paths. Seekhne ke liye useful; behaviour ka proof nahi.
sim_l2_desc: Un tests ke results jo sach mein (user ki permission se) chalaye gaye. Sirf chalaye gaye tests report hote hain.
sim_l3_desc: Instrumentation ke saath program ke asli run ke dauraan record hue function calls.
no_test_runs: Koi test run record nahi hai. Plan banao aur (permission ke baad) tests chalao:
no_runtime: Abhi koi runtime trace nahi hai. Permission ke saath chalao:
top_functions: Sabse zyaada call hue repository functions
